title: Wet areas.
officialText:
Showers and public toilet walls shall conform to Sections 1210.2 and 1210.3. When wood frame walls and
partitions are covered on the interior with cement plaster or tile of similar material and are subject to water splash, the framing
shall be protected with an approved moisture barrier.
SECTION BC 2512
EXTERIOR PLASTER
